summary: Both editions were reviewed independently against all ten paragraphs of the selected Greek. No concrete fidelity defect was identified. Both retain the prayer’s requests, purposes and stated reason; the repeated warning and narrator’s self-question; the distinct distances and beast dimensions; the clothing image and disclosed faith genitive; the beast’s capacity to ravage a city; both restrictive motion statements and their temporal boundary; and the four color groups. Reader-facing servants and contextual repentance follow current policy. The supplied antecedent “vision” is explicitly disclosed as an editorial completion. Variant notes are consistent with the bounded supplemental reports and distinguish corrections, restorations, conjectures and mediated version evidence without replacing the selected readings. Acceptance concerns the supplied working source and disclosure, not authentication of unseen images, unique interpretation or exhaustive scholarly collation.
